pages.text: “Refreshing and delicate, bitter at first but sweet aftertaste. Tender leaves unfold, granting a light and swift step.”$(br2)Green Tea is a revitalizing drink made from two portions of dried green tea leaves. The tea liquor is bright green, with a slight bitterness that turns into a lingering sweetness. Drinking it provides a Speed boost, making travelers feel lighter on their feet.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Green Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried green tea leaves.$(br)It is an excellent choice for long-distance travel or exploration, allowing you to move more swiftly and effortlessly.

Upon drinking Green Tea, travelers gain a temporary Speed boost, increasing their movement speed.$(br)This light and refreshing tea is perfect for traveling and exploration.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
